spec.formattedQuery: SELECT $timeSeries as t, count() FROM $table WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY t ORDER BY t
spec.query:
SELECT
  toStartOfDay($dateCol) as t,
  sum(total) as "Converted"

FROM
  $table

WHERE
  toDate($from) <= $dateCol AND
  toDate($to) >= $dateCol AND
  pixel_id = '$pixel_id' AND
  date >= '$start_date' AND
  pixel = '$convert'

GROUP BY
  t

ORDER BY
  t WITH FILL
    FROM toStartOfDay(toDateTime($from))
    TO toStartOfDay(toDateTime($to))
    STEP INTERVAL 1 DAY
spec.rawQuery:
/* grafana dashboard=Subscription Support Bot, user=164 */
SELECT
  toStartOfDay(date) as t,
  sum(total) as "Converted"

FROM
  metrics.pixels_aggregation

WHERE
  toDate(1770056960) <= date AND
  toDate(1772648960) >= date AND
  pixel_id = 'subscriptionsupport' AND
  date >= '2026-01-01' AND
  pixel = 'subscriptionsupport.link.ticket'

GROUP BY
  t,

ORDER BY
  t WITH FILL
    FROM toStartOfDay(toDateTime(1770056960))
    TO toStartOfDay(toDateTime(1772648960))
    STEP INTERVAL 1 DAY

  toStartOfDay($dateCol) as t,
  $slug as slug,

  $table

  toDate($from) <= $dateCol AND
  toDate($to) >= $dateCol AND
  pixel_id = '$pixel_id' AND
  date >= '$start_date' AND
  startsWith(pixel, '$article')

GROUP BY
  t,
  slug

  slug,
  t WITH FILL

    TO toStartOfDay(toDateTime($to))
    STEP INTERVAL 1 DAY
